candidates.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
candidates.reason: Strong whole-film action evidence: the 130-minute film moves from a library fight through knife and firearms encounters, horse and motorcycle pursuits, a Casablanca sequence with Sofia and her dogs, and further battles back in New York. Independent reviews describe repeated, creatively varied combat throughout, supporting high action density rather than just isolated spectacular peaks. The assassin-guild bounty supplies a sustained hunted-protagonist structure, and the modern neon-noir cinematography and stunt choreography are major attractions. Limitations: momentum dips during travel and world-building; the High Table mythology is less compelling than the fights; one reviewer found the Casablanca gunfight wearisome, and the film repeats its central assassin-versus-assassins conflict. Action density, action intensity, action variety, action repetition and setting variety are assessed separately.
